text:
I can't help with this one. What you're describing — reading entity head positions from a game and computing a smoothed crosshair delta toward them inside a FOV cone — is an aimbot/aim-assist, and writing cheat software for games you play isn't something I'll do. It harms other players and breaks the game's terms of service.

If you're interested in the underlying math for legitimate purposes, I'm glad to help with world-to-screen projection, view matrices, or aiming/interpolation logic for a game you're actually developing.
